content.short: Blockfence is a browser extension that enhances security for crypto users in Web3.
content.description: Blockfence is a browser extension that strengthens security for cryptocurrency users navigating Web3. It continuously monitors both the browser environment and on-chain activity to detect signs of risk, and it promptly issues alerts to help users respond. By combining advanced threat detection with a machine-learning engine and layered protective measures, Blockfence delivers multi-layered protection across the full interaction flow—from browsing to signing transactions and interacting with decentralized apps. This approach empowers users to stay informed, exercise caution, and participate more safely in the Web3 ecosystem.
